page.notes: The right printed page is cut off at the scan edge; only its edge fragments are visible, so nothing from it is transcribed. The running head shows "LIB.III" beside "Scutum Regium." on this page; only the title is given as running head. "quâ ꝓphibuit" is uncertain (the ꝓ abbreviation could be read differently). The square bracket before "Inter" and the one after "inveniat." are printed. No catchword or signature is visible. Printed spelling kept: "pijssimū", "idē", "nō", "tũ".
